package appliance

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	management "github.com/caelis-labs/memory/api/memory/management/v1alpha1"
	steward "github.com/caelis-labs/memory/api/memory/steward/v1alpha1"
	memory "github.com/caelis-labs/memory/api/memory/v1alpha1"
	"github.com/caelis-labs/memory/sdk/go/memory/stewardworker"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// Copy only this test into the exact released source and run it there. No
// current implementation or synthetic schema is used to produce old stores.
func TestGenerateReleasedStewardUpgradeFixture(t *testing.T) {
	output, release, commit := os.Getenv("RELEASE_FIXTURE_OUTPUT"), os.Getenv("RELEASE_FIXTURE_TAG"), os.Getenv("RELEASE_FIXTURE_COMMIT")
	if output == "" || release == "" || commit == "" {
		t.Fatal("fixture provenance/output missing")
	}
	now := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	dir := t.TempDir()
	s, err := Open(t.Context(), Options{DataDir: dir, Clock: func() time.Time { return now }, Random: rand.New(rand.NewSource(601))})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer s.Close()
	operations := []memory.Operation{memory.OperationRemember, memory.OperationRecall, memory.OperationReceiptStatus}
	bootstrap, err := s.Bootstrap(t.Context(), management.BootstrapRequest{
		Realms:           []management.Realm{{ID: "realm:upgrade"}},
		Identities:       []management.Identity{{ID: "identity:upgrade", RealmID: "realm:upgrade"}},
		Spaces:           []management.Space{{ID: "space:upgrade", RealmID: "realm:upgrade", IdentityID: "identity:upgrade", Class: memory.SpaceClassPrivate}},
		Views:            []management.ViewDefinition{{ID: "view:upgrade", RealmID: "realm:upgrade", ReadSpaceIDs: []memory.SpaceID{"space:upgrade"}, WriteSpaceID: "space:upgrade", MaxDisclosureClass: memory.SpaceClassPrivate, Version: 1}},
		Grants:           []management.Grant{{ID: "grant:upgrade", PrincipalRef: "principal:upgrade", ActorRef: "actor:upgrade", ViewRef: "view:upgrade", AllowedOperations: operations, AllowedAudiences: []memory.Audience{memory.AudiencePrivate}, ExpiresAt: time.Date(2099, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Version: 1}},
		IssuerPrincipals: []string{"principal:upgrade"},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	labels := memory.LabelSet{"workspace:upgrade"}
	cap, err := s.IssueCapability(t.Context(), IssueCapabilityRequest{Authorization: IssuerAuthorization{PrincipalRef: "principal:upgrade", Credential: bootstrap.IssuerCredentials["principal:upgrade"]}, GrantRef: "grant:upgrade", ActorRef: "actor:upgrade", Audience: memory.AudiencePrivate, Operations: operations, Labels: labels, TTLSeconds: 3600})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	auth := memory.CallAuthorization{Capability: cap.Token, ActorRef: "actor:upgrade", Audience: memory.AudiencePrivate}
	profile := stewardworker.BuiltInProfile()
	custom := profile
	custom.ProfileID = "consumer-custom"
	custom.Version = 7
	custom.SystemPrompt = "Keep this independently owned policy unchanged."
	for _, p := range []steward.ProfileSpec{profile, custom} {
		if _, err := s.PutStewardProfile(t.Context(), management.PutStewardProfileRequest{Profile: p}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if _, err := s.BindStewardProfile(t.Context(), management.BindStewardProfileRequest{ProfileID: profile.ProfileID, Version: profile.Version, SpaceIDs: []memory.SpaceID{"space:upgrade"}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	type receiptFixture struct {
		Request  memory.RememberRequest  `json:"request"`
		Response memory.RememberResponse `json:"response"`
	}
	var receipts []receiptFixture
	var leased StewardWork
	for i, text := range []string{"old leased evidence", "old pending evidence"} {
		request := memory.RememberRequest{Text: text, IdempotencyKey: text, SourceContext: memory.SourceContext{SourceType: "release_fixture"}}
		response, err := s.Remember(t.Context(), auth, request)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		receipts = append(receipts, receiptFixture{request, response})
		if i == 0 {
			var found bool
			leased, found, err = s.ClaimStewardJob(t.Context(), time.Minute)
			if err != nil || !found {
				t.Fatalf("claim %v %v", found, err)
			}
		}
		now = now.Add(time.Second)
	}
	var schema int
	if err := s.db.QueryRow(`SELECT MAX(version) FROM schema_migrations`).Scan(&schema); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := s.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(output, 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hashes := map[string]string{}
	for _, name := range []string{DatabaseFilename, ManagementCredentialFile, StewardWorkerCredentialFile} {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, name))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		target := name
		if name != DatabaseFilename {
			target += ".txt"
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, target), raw, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
		hashes[target] = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	}
	manifest := map[string]any{"source_tag": release, "source_commit": commit, "schema_version": schema, "generated_at": now, "files_sha256": hashes, "profile": profile, "custom_profile": custom, "labels": labels, "test_only_issuer_credential": bootstrap.IssuerCredentials["principal:upgrade"], "receipts": receipts, "leased_work": leased}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(manifest, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, "manifest.json"), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
